summary: Frontend bug fix verified: PriceBookPicker.js now correctly handles price_other/unit_other for labor category. Both the picker display (Info column shows 'kg: 10,00 zł') and the click-to-pick action (propagates unit_price_netto=10 and unit='kg' to the labor sub-row) work as expected. Regression test for price_m2 also passes — m² items still display correctly and show '≠kg' mismatch warning when posUnit differs.
critical_code_review_comments: PriceBookPicker.js getEffective for labor correctly prioritizes price_other when unit_other matches posUnit (idealny match), then falls back to price_m2/m3/mb/szt with mismatch flag — logic is sound.
getExtraInfo() displays both old price_m2/m3/mb/szt and new price_other in Info column — consistent UX.
Note: AdminDashboard shows a 'Włącz powiadomienia' modal on every login that overlays the UI; testers must dismiss it before interacting — not a bug per se but a UX friction point.
seed_data_creation: Created via API: 1 wycena (TEST_iter95bu_picker_labor), 1 stage, 1 position (unit=kg), 1 labor line (unit=kg, price=0), 2 labor pricebook items (TEST_iter95bu_przygotowanie_zbrojenia price_other=10/unit_other=kg, TEST_iter95bu_tynk_m2 price_m2=35). All seed data deleted after test (200 OK on cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PriceBookPicker labor flow validated end-to-end. Test wycena WID=77d1047c... and seeded labor items were cleaned up.
